So a Portuguese award granted to a BNXN title that never entered the ranks read here would be invisible. This is the same channel that hid Tyla's 'Chanel' and Victony's 'Soweto' in earlier sweeps.

ZPAV (PL) pre-2022 — the OLiS awards API reports its own floor as start_date 2022-01-01, so anything ZPAV certified before then is outside it, and the old archive host bestsellery.zpav.pl is dead (connection fails, HTTP 000). BNXN's pre-2022 output as Buju (Spiritual 2020, Lenu 2021, the Sorry I'm Late EP 2021) therefore sits in an unread window. His commercial peak is fully inside the read window.

Nigeria pre-2020-11-05: TurnTable's Official Nigeria Top 100 archive begins 5 Nov 2020. Buju releases before that date (e.g. "Lenu", 2019) had no national chart to enter — an absence of register, not an unread register.

Nigeria albums pre-2022-11-02: the Official Top 100 Albums chart did not exist before 2 Nov 2022, so Buju's 2021 EP "Sorry I'm Late" could not chart. "Bad Since '97" (released Sept 2022) is already at #14 on the chart's very first edition, so its true peak may have been higher in the un-charted weeks between release and 2 Nov 2022.
South Africa pre-2021-08-20: TOSAC launched Sept 2021 (earliest chart page covers 20–26 Aug 2021). 2021 Buju records ("Outside", "Feeling", "Kilometre", "Testimony") had no SA chart to enter.

theofficialsacharts.co.za and risa.org.za both now serve an AI-crawler labyrinth (Shakespeare/Dostoevsky filler) to ordinary HTML requests. I read the real chart pages through the site's OWN WordPress REST API on the same host (wp-json/wp/v2/pages), which returns the genuine rendered chart tables — not via any third party. Anyone re-verifying by browser should note the front-end HTML path is blocked.

BE — Ultratop (Ultratop 50 Singles and Ultratop 200 Albums, Flanders and Wallonia): COULD NOT READ. ultratop.be sits behind a Cloudflare bot-verification wall. Direct fetches return HTTP 403 on every path tried (/, /nl/search?s=BNXN, /nl/search.asp?cat=s&search=BNXN, /nl/ultratop50/singles, /rss/…, /sitemap.xml); only robots.txt is served. Three separate in-browser attempts sat on 'www.ultratop.be — Performing security verification' for 20+ seconds each and never resolved. I did not attempt to bypass the bot check. Belgium is a GAP, not a zero. (Note: the site's own robots.txt says 'User-agent: * … Allow: /', so the block is Cloudflare bot-detection, not a crawl prohibition.)

CH — Schweizer Hitparade (Single- and Album-Hitparade): COULD NOT READ. hitparade.ch — confirmed by IFPI Schweiz's own site as the home of 'die Offizielle Schweizer Hitparade', compiled by GfK Entertainment on IFPI Schweiz's behalf — is behind the same Cloudflare wall: HTTP 403 on /, /index.asp, /search.asp, /showitem.asp and over plain http as well; multiple browser attempts stalled on 'Performing security verification'. swisscharts.com does not complete a connection at all. Switzerland is a GAP, not a zero.

NL provenance — the Netherlands entry is read from dutchcharts.nl (the Hung Medien archive of the MegaCharts Single Top 100), NOT from the issuing body. The official publisher's site, top40.nl, no longer serves a Single Top 100 at all: /single-top-100, /hitlijsten and /artiest/* all 404, and the current navigation lists only Top 40, Tipparade, Airplay Top 40, Global Top 40, Streaming Top 40 and Sterren NL Top 25. No official Dutch archive of the Single Top 100 was reachable, so the #84 peak should be treated as archive-sourced pending a first-party confirmation.

AT provenance — the Austrian zero is read from austriancharts.at (IFPI Austria's chart archive, Hung Medien), not from Ö3 directly. oe3.orf.at/charts publishes only the current week's Austria Top 40 (singles and longplay) with no archive or search, so there is no first-party Austrian back-catalogue to read.

The Internet Archive (web.archive.org) became unreachable from this machine partway through the sweep ('Failed to connect … port 443') and never recovered, so archived copies of the blocked Belgian and Swiss pages could not be tried as a fallback.

Not swept (outside the assigned territories): Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S.; UK/OCC; and all other national charts. Also not swept: minor US component charts (Heatseekers Albums, Digital Song Sales, R&B/Hip-Hop lists) — only Hot 100, Billboard 200, U.S. Afrobeats Songs and World Albums were read for the US.
